html:
An Athenian who questioned people about justice, courage and the good life, and showed them how little they knew. He wrote nothing; we know him through Plato, Xenophon and the comedies of Aristophanes.

He served as a soldier in the Peloponnesian War. In 399 BCE, a few years after the war was lost, Athens tried him for impiety and corrupting the young, and he was put to death by hemlock.
